PROMOTED 2026-08-17 (session nyiso-calibration-declaration). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-17-nyiso-142-stackdup (bundle results/calibration/nyiso142_stackdup), superseding 2026-08-16-nyiso-140-layup-exclusion. OWNER RULING, this session, verbatim: "Is this a recommended keeper candidate? If so plz promote. If structural integrity improves but gates regress that may still be a keeper." The session's recommendation was PROMOTE, and the structure-over-gates clause is NOT needed: NO gated criterion regresses. Both runs read CALIBRATED under rubric v3.3, criterion for criterion identical -- 0 FAILs, C1/C2/C3a/C3b/C4/C6/C8 all PASS, C3c the same lone ledgered caveat, BIT-UNCHANGED at 21 / 3 / 24 h; grade summary scored 8 / target-grade 7 / commercial-grade 0 / ledgered 1.

NO NEW SOLVE FOR THE PROMOTION. The A/B was pre-registered, solved and adjudicated at nyiso-142 (control 2026-08-17-nyiso-142-control), then held. NO CELL VERDICT MOVES: this is a DATA CORRECTION, not a lever (rule 28 -- plant_emission_rates_v2 stays K, evidence citation already added at nyiso-142).

WHAT IS CORRECTED: Astoria's CAMPD/CEMS reports ONE generator TWICE. campd.CAMPD_STACK_DUPLICATE_UNITS is live and scripts/data/repair_v2_stack_duplicate_rows.py folds the 18 stack-duplicate plant_emission_rates_v2 rows onto their primaries across 2018-2026 with every other row asserted byte-frozen. The SURGICAL route was required: the default derive path is a REPLACE and would have destroyed the 2018 rows (no longer buildable) and the 2022/2026 holdout-intake rows (unrepeatable). Validated MATCH against a freshly curated emissions-unit-annual on every field for all six rebuildable years. Rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]: a double-counted generator is a measurement artifact, and the corrected series is the truthful one whatever it does to the residual.

ALL SIX PRE-REGISTERED GATES CLEAN. K1' 718/718 scenario_config fields identical with sorted-config sha256 identical -- the arm changes NO model parameter -- and the artifact diff is 17 CSV lines ALL keyed NYISO,8906. K2 slack/dump 0.0 in all six run-years. K3 benchmark 2.6722 -> 1.3590 exactly. K4 ZERO other plants move. K5 identical criterion statuses. K6' D-1/D-2/D-4 pass both arms with NO D-2 forced share moving at all. chp-btm-share is byte-identical across the correction in EVERY ISO, so the clean-tree channel is empty and the pair differs by exactly the source table and those 18 rows (rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE] respected: no other ISO is touched).

ZERO FREE PARAMETERS (rule 21 [R-DOF], n_residual UNCHANGED). Rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE]: the trigger is the SOURCE DATA (CAMPD's own duplicate stack rows), not a residual.

THE HONEST HEADLINE, carried from the prereg: 2025's movement is MOSTLY THE TARGET MOVING (benchmark -1.204 TWh) not the model improving (-0.213). ST_GAS error 2023 +2.263 -> +2.178, 2024 -0.916 -> -1.062 (WORSE -- the pre-registered adverse case, landing on a year whose target was already right), 2025 -3.737 -> -2.746; summed |error| 6.916 -> 5.986 TWh, which is a CONSEQUENCE and not the argument (rule 1 [R-STRUCT]). LMP +0.06/+0.10/+0.21 $/MWh.

P7 REFUTED IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION, disclosed as the prereg committed: it predicted NYISO CO2 metrics would RISE; the 2025 benchmark eGRID total FELL 29.167 -> 28.335 Mt. The reasoning error was that the doubling was in GENERATION only -- heat and masses always summed correctly -- so class CO2 mass was never understated. C5a is reported-only and gates nothing.

NOT PRE-REGISTERED, DISCLOSED, AND THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR A LATER READER: the 2025 correction moves SIX class benchmarks. As ST_GAS falls 1.204 the others rise by the same total (CC_REGULAR +0.787, CC_CHP +0.281, CT_PEAKER +0.066, CT_CHP +0.056, ST_CHP +0.015) via the ISO-total reconciliation, flattering CC_REGULAR 2025 from +2.877 to +2.229. EVERY NYISO RUN EVER SCORED ON 2025 WAS SCORED AGAINST AN INFLATED ST_GAS TARGET, so post-correction 2025 figures are NOT comparable to committed pre-correction ones. 2023/2024 bench bytes change (c_ann 1.546 -> 0.780, 1.850 -> 0.930) while the SCORED target does not. THIS IS THE REASON THE PROMOTION MATTERS BEYOND THE VOLUME: the incumbent's solve inputs embedded the artifact while the benchmark has since been corrected; the promoted run is the internally consistent pair.

SUCCESSOR UNCHANGED AND LOCALISED TO ZONE J (nyiso-142 job 3): NYC is the ONLY zone whose CC_REGULAR falls (-0.959 TWh) and carries the largest ST_GAS rise (+1.84 net of the double-count); the three in-city CCs book +536 unit-outage-days in 2025 vs 2023 and Astoria Energy's metered gross falls 8.29 -> 6.33 TWh. Three readings REFUTED (plumbing -- the outages DO reach the LP, availability 0.868 -> 0.552; the Ravenswood _FLEET_GROUP_OVERRIDE contamination, 4.5 of 256.7 equivalent full-outage days; and the transfer bound -- nyiso_nyc_lcr_tsl is armed and working but Lower_Hudson>NYC binds in only 0.3/2.7/1.6 % of hours). What survives is a COMMITMENT question: named successor nyiso_incity_commitment_obligation (matrix cell U) -- named, not armed, no parameter derived.

Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso142-incity-cc-outage-substitution-2026-08-17.md, ASSESSMENT-nyiso142-final-readiness-2026-08-17.md; repair scripts/data/repair_v2_stack_duplicate_rows.py.

frontier_cleared.by: OWNER DECISION, session nyiso-130, 2026-08-06: clear the frontier block and clear NYISO's frontier status.
frontier_cleared.reason: The frontier claim's load-bearing limb is FALSE at HEAD. The owner's own definition of frontier is 'we have tested everything we could have' (2026-08-04 restatement, docs/mechanism-testing-matrix.md caiso-171 block), and nyiso-130 OPENED a new, named, untested object: NYISO publishes, in TABLE 1 note 2 of the Locality Bulk Power Transmission Capability Reports, that the Zone-K 'Locality Limit' the model uses as an hourly bound is the transfer limit NET of a 660 MW generation loss-of-source ('the true N-1-1 Transmission Security Limit is 940 in this scenario'). 100 % of the model's C3c tail hours in ALL THREE years form at that one in-window bound. The obvious fix was pre-registered, tested and REJECTED by its own kill gate (the downstate ST_GAS reliability floor takes up the slack), so the successor is a JOINT reconciliation of the transfer bound and the min_gen floor under rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH] — chartered, not exhausted. A frontier claim cannot stand on an exhaustion premise the same session falsified. nyiso-127 §2 had already recommended re-declaration over a third amendment, listing four falsified clauses; the owner chose to clear rather than re-declare. THIS IS NOT A DETERMINATION CHANGE: NYISO reads CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS on 2026-08-06-nyiso-128-solar-basis and the `complete` marker is untouched — but neither now rests on a frontier claim.

withdrawn_note_preserved_verbatim.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
withdrawn_note_preserved_verbatim.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
